$comment: A PASTED NAME IS ORDERED WHERE IT IS WRITTEN (P69 round 1, lane cs, fold f26c). The C front end answered 'is A written before B' by byte offset, which a token the preprocessor materializes (a paste's product, in the synth buffer's product tail) does not keep: a struct with a pasted tag was incomplete for every later function, a declaration with a pasted name was not seen by a later sizeof (a wrong value), and a const object with a pasted initializer was not visible to a later static initializer (probes fp3-fp6). Every order question now reads the token-stream order (semantic_analyzer.cpp streamRank). gcc, clang, mingw-w64 gcc and Apple clang run every form to 42. Each return before 42 names the first form that failed.
